en.headline: Exchange Fund posts HK$18.6 billion third-quarter income
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said investment income dropped sharply year on year amid market volatility, though Hong Kong equities returned to profit.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the Exchange Fund recorded investment income of HK$18.6 billion in the third quarter of 2026, a decline of about 74 per cent from the same period a year earlier.

Hong Kong equities contributed a profit of HK$9.1 billion in the quarter, reversing three consecutive quarters of losses, while other equities added HK$1.5 billion. Bonds yielded HK$0.3 billion and foreign-exchange gains totalled HK$7.7 billion.

For the first three quarters, cumulative investment income reached HK$171.9 billion before certain valuation adjustments. HKMA Chief Executive Eddie Yue said the fourth quarter would remain challenging amid global uncertainty and advised focusing on long-term performance rather than quarterly fluctuations.

zh.headline: 外匯基金第三季投資收入186億元
zh.dek: 金管局表示第三季投資收入按年大幅下跌，但港股轉虧為盈。
body: 香港金融管理局表示，外匯基金於2026年第三季錄得投資收入186億港元，較去年同期下降約74%。
期內港股錄得91億元盈利，扭轉連續三季虧損，其他股票貢獻15億元，債券0.3億元，外匯收益77億元。
首三季累計投資收入達1719億元（未計入部分估值變動）。金管局總裁余偉文表示，第四季仍充滿挑戰，市民應著眼長期表現，而非季度波動。
